entries.title: Binary Search
entries.blurb: Implement a binary search algorithm.

entries.blurb: Given a natural radicand, return its square root.

entries.title: Matching Brackets
entries.blurb: Make sure the brackets and braces all match.

entries.title: Isogram
entries.blurb: Determine whether a phrase is an isogram, a word with no repeated letters.

entries.title: Anagram
entries.blurb: Find the words that use the same letters as another word.
entries.source: Inspired by the Extreme Startup game

entries.title: Pangram
entries.blurb: Determine whether a phrase uses every letter in the Latin alphabet.

entries.title: Word Count
entries.blurb: Given a phrase, count the occurrences of each word in that phrase.
entries.source: This is a classic toy problem, but we were reminded of it by seeing it in the Go Tour.

entries.title: ETL
entries.blurb: Change the data format for scoring a game to more easily add other languages.
entries.source: Based on an exercise by the JumpstartLab team for students at The Turing School of Software and Design.

entries.blurb: Score a single throw of dice in the game Yacht.

entries.title: Acronym

entries.title: ISBN Verifier
entries.blurb: Check if a given string is a valid ISBN-10 number.
entries.source: Converting a string into a number and some basic processing utilizing a relatable real world example.

entries.title: Luhn
entries.blurb: Given a number determine whether or not it is valid per the Luhn formula.

entries.title: Run-Length Encoding
entries.blurb: Implement run-length encoding and decoding.

entries.title: Sieve
entries.blurb: Use the Sieve of Eratosthenes to find all the primes from 2 up to a given number.

entries.title: Prime Factors
entries.blurb: Compute the prime factors of a given natural number.
entries.source: The Prime Factors Kata by Uncle Bob

entries.title: Pig Latin

entries.source: The Pig Latin exercise at Test First Teaching by Ultrasaurus

entries.title: Saddle Points
entries.blurb: Detect saddle points in a matrix.

entries.title: Conway's Game of Life
entries.blurb: Implement Conway's Game of Life.

entries.title: Flower Field
entries.blurb: Mark all the flowers in a garden.

entries.blurb: Implement encoding and decoding for the rail fence cipher.

entries.title: All Your Base
entries.blurb: Convert a number, represented as a sequence of digits in one base, to any other base.

entries.title: Rectangles
entries.blurb: Count the rectangles in an ASCII diagram.

entries.blurb: Determine if a list is a sublist of another list.

entries.blurb: Calculate the number of steps to reach 1 using the Collatz conjecture.

entries.title: Flatten Array
entries.blurb: Take a nested list and return a single list with all values except nil/null.

entries.title: Killer Sudoku Helper
entries.blurb: Write a tool that makes it easier to solve Killer Sudokus
entries.source: Created by Sascha Mann, Jeremy Walker, and BethanyG for the Julia track on Exercism.

entries.title: Knapsack
entries.blurb: Given a knapsack that can only carry a certain weight, determine which items to put in the knapsack in order to maximize their combined value.

entries.source: Inspired by the harry potter kata from Cyber-Dojo.

entries.title: Connect
entries.blurb: Compute the result for a game of Hex / Polygon.
